parameters.content:
## Label invoice and receipt emails in Gmail with a local Ollama model

For freelancers and small businesses whose invoices, receipts and bills get lost among other email. Every new inbox email is checked, and the ones that ask for or confirm a payment get a Gmail label you choose, such as Invoices. At month end, one click on that label shows everything for your bookkeeping.

The check runs on your own machine through Ollama, so there is no AI bill and no email text goes to an AI company.

### How it works
1. The Gmail Trigger checks for new inbox emails every minute and downloads their attachments.
2. The sender, subject, attachment file names and the start of the body are sent to Ollama. The file contents are not read.
3. The model answers whether this is an invoice, receipt, bill or payment reminder, and names the vendor.
4. The label is added only when the model says yes and names one of those kinds. Quotes, newsletters and shipping updates are left alone.

### Setup
1. Install Ollama and pull a model, for example `ollama pull qwen2.5:3b`.
2. In Gmail, create the label you want, for example Invoices.
3. Connect a Gmail OAuth2 credential on **Watch Gmail Inbox** and **Add Invoice Label**.
4. Open **Add Invoice Label** and pick your label in Label Names or IDs.
5. If n8n runs in Docker, set ollama_url in **Set Label Settings** to `http://host.docker.internal:11434`.
6. Activate the workflow.

### Customization tips
The attachments travel with each labelled email, so you can add a node after Add Invoice Label to save the PDFs wherever you keep them.

## Watch the inbox

New inbox emails arrive with their attachments. Set Label Settings holds the model and its address.

## Ask the model

Sender, subject, attachment names and the start of the body go to Ollama, which answers invoice or not.

## Label it

Invoices, receipts, bills and reminders get your label. Everything else is left as it was.
